item.title: ベッセント米財務長官が目指す財政赤字削減策、厳しい現実に直面必至
item.description: （ブルームバーグ）：
item.dc:creator: Bloomberg
item.content:encoded:
（ブルームバーグ）： ベッセント米財務長官は数日中に財政赤字削減策を公表すると約束している。だが、そうした施策も厳しい現実に直面することになる。共和党が支配する議会では今年、歳出を純減させる動きが全く見られない。

同党のティリス上院議員は24日、連邦議会議事堂で記者団に対し、「政治情勢を考えれば、財政赤字を巡り何か動きがあるとは思わない」と述べるとともに、財政赤字削減は「正しいことではあるが、選挙で支持を得られる人気の争点ではない」と語った。

上下両院の共和党は今夏、数千億ドル規模の歳出削減計画を撤回した。11月の中間選挙で接戦が予想される選挙区の同党議員から、有権者の反発を懸念する声が上がった。

党指導部はその代わり、選挙後に案をまとめると約束した。一方、下院は今年、950億ドル（約15兆1180億円）の追加支出を盛り込んだ法案を推進。主な目的は対イラン戦争の資金を賄うもので、相殺する歳出削減を伴わず、財政赤字を拡大させる内容だ。上院はまだこの法案を審議していない。

下院指導部はメディケイド（低所得者向け医療保険制度）や、その他の給付制度で不正が行われていると主張し、そうした行為を対象とした歳出抑制の法案を選挙後に提出するとしている。これにより約2000億ドルの節減が見込まれる可能性がある。

しかし、国防費をさらに3500億ドル増やす計画により、こうした節減の見込みも帳消しになる。民主党が中間選挙で勝利し、意気消沈した共和党議員を12月に結束させるのが難しくなれば、この案が可決されるかどうかも不透明だ。

財政赤字や債務が頻繁に話題に上る米議会だが、トランプ政権2期目で財政状況は一段と悪化している。

トランプ大統領の看板政策である減税・歳出法案は昨年、議会で可決され成立。10年間で財政赤字を4兆1000億ドル押し上げる。財政赤字削減を重視し、中間選挙の共和党予備選で敗れたマッシー下院議員は先週のSNS投稿で、「常識的な知能がある人なら誰でも、減税と歳出拡大で財政赤字が膨れ上がることは分かっていた」とコメントした。

item.title: Veteran WR Allen Robinson announces retirement
item.description: Former Jacksonville Jaguars and Chicago Bears star wide receiver Allen Robinson announced his retirement from football on Monday, his 33rd birthday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Former Jacksonville Jaguars and Chicago Bears star wide receiver Allen Robinson announced his retirement from football on Monday, his 33rd birthday. Robinson did not play in the NFL last season. Most recently, he appeared in 12 games for the Detroit Lions in 2024. "This birthday feels a little different. It marks not only another year, but the beginning of a new chapter," Robinson wrote on Instagram in a post that accompanied a narrated video essay. "To every love story, there comes a final chapter. Football gave me more than I ever could've imagined. It challenged me, shaped me, humbled me, and rewarded me in ways I'll carry for the rest of my life. I came, I saw, I conquered and I leave with nothing but gratitude. "The memories, the relationships, the victories, the lessons, they'll stay with me forever!" Robinson was a second-round draft pick by the Jaguars in 2014 and broke out in his second NFL season. He led the league with 14 touchdown receptions, recorded 1,400 yards (which would remain his career high) and made his only Pro Bowl. After four seasons with the Jaguars, Robinson spent four seasons in Chicago and was the Bears' leader in receptions in 2018, 2019 and 2020. Across 11 NFL seasons with the Jaguars (2014-17), Bears (2018-21), Los Angeles Rams (2022), Pittsburgh Steelers (2023) and Lions (2024), Robinson caught 565 passes for 7,058 yards and 43 touchdowns. --Field Level Media

item.title: Fire crews gain ground on destructive blaze raging near Reno, Nevada
item.description: Firefighters logged major gains on Monday against a wind-driven blaze that threatened the city of Reno, Nevada, over the weekend, destroying dozens of houses and chasing tens of thousands of people from their homes.
item.dc:creator: Fred Greaves, Steve Gorman
item.content:encoded: Firefighters logged major gains on Monday against a wind-driven blaze that threatened the city of Reno, Nevada, over the weekend, destroying dozens of houses and chasing tens of thousands of people from their homes. As of Monday, fire crews had managed to carve containment lines around 27% of the Hawk Fire, which erupted on Saturday near Nevada's third-most-populous city and raced through tinder-dry grass, brush and forest into residential areas. Within 48 hours, the blaze had scorched more than 15,000 acres (6,070 hectares) on the outskirts of Reno, a hub of high-tech industry, gambling and outdoor resorts in the eastern foothills of the Sierra Nevada mountain range near the California border. It was the second major wildfire to strike Nevada's Truckee River valley area in recent weeks. No fatalities have been reported, but four civilians and three emergency personnel suffered minor burns in the initial hours of the blaze on Saturday, authorities said. Chief Richard Edwards of the Truckee Meadows Fire Protection District told a press conference that at least 32 homes had gone up in flames, with a half dozen more damaged. The tally of property losses is expected to climb as damage-assessment teams canvass more of the fire zone in the coming days, he said. NEIGHBORHOOD IN FLAMES Among the ill-fated property owners was Luke Opperman, 47, a civil engineer who lost his family's home of nearly 20 years when flames swept their suburban Reno neighborhood. Opperman, who was away camping at the time, said his wife and two teenage daughters hastily packed up three cars and two trailers with clothes, vital belongings and the family's chickens, goats, dog and cats, then sped off to safety as the fire closed in around them. The outpouring of support from co-workers and friends, some of whom had already started a GoFundMe page for his family, was overwhelming, Opperman recalled. "That's what made me break down," he said. Devastation to the area as a whole was staggering, he said, with six of his neighbors also losing their homes. He estimated as many as 20 houses had burned up in his immediate community, which lies adjacent to the Humboldt-Toiyabe National Forest. "It's more than just a house; it's your neighborhood, it's your community," Opperman told Reuters, his voice cracking with emotion, in a telephone interview, adding he had yet to fully contemplate what happens next. "I think it's baby steps," he said. "I don't know what's happening at the end of this week." THREAT DIMINISHES As the fire raged out of control over the weekend, wind-whipped flames roared up canyon slopes and over fire trucks while authorities issued evacuation notices urging an estimated 90,000 residents to leave their homes immediately or get set to flee. By Monday afternoon, the fire threat had diminished enough for officials to lift evacuations in some areas, but Sheriff Darin Balaam said 23,000 residents were still displaced under "go-now" orders, with another 40,000 advised to be ready to go at a moment's notice. More than 900 firefighters remained assigned to the Hawk Fire on Monday, Edwards said, including personnel from 15 U.S. states as well as crews from Australia and New Zealand who were part of teams dispatched from abroad to help battle dozens of blazes raging across the Western U.S. in recent weeks. Officials said the Hawk Fire was human-caused, but whether it was intentionally set or ignited by accident remained under investigation.

item.title: Iran vows to retaliate after US widens sanctions
item.description: Iran promised to retaliate against expanded U.S. sanctions that the Americans said would cut Iran's economic lifeline, with Tehran expressing confidence that major trading partners would resist Washington's pressure campaign.
item.dc:creator: Yasmine Ghania, David Lawder
item.content:encoded: Iran promised to retaliate against expanded U.S. sanctions that the Americans said would cut Iran's economic lifeline, with Tehran expressing confidence that major trading partners would resist Washington's pressure campaign. U.S. Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent [USN:L1N44L0FC TEXT:"unveiled the measures"] on Monday but stopped short of the most punishing sanctions, saying countries that continued trading with Iran risked being forced out of the dollar-based financial system. Bessent declined to identify the countries that would be targeted or reveal when the penalties would take effect, saying he would instead give them time to comply with the new directive. The Treasury Department did announce new sanctions on 60 individuals, entities and vessels, but the list did not feature any of the Chinese financial institutions suspected of facilitating Iran's oil trade. Before the news, Iran threatened both a possible military response and further reduction in oil exports from the Gulf in retaliation for any U.S. economic measures. After they were unveiled, Iranian Economy Minister Ali Madanizadeh said, "We are fully prepared for the U.S. sanctions." He told state television, "Naturally, the enemies intend to launch an economic terrorist attack on us, but we also have our own tools and know how to play the game. Our defense is no longer so defensive; the enemies should wait for an attack." Neither China nor Russia had "accepted" the U.S. measures, he added, predicting that other countries would resist them. Brigadier General Hossein Mohebbi, a spokesperson for Iran's Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps, vowed heavy blows to U.S. vital interests and energy chokepoints if Iran's infrastructure is threatened, Press TV reported. Iran and the United States signed an interim peace deal in June, but the Islamabad memorandum, as it is known, quickly faltered. Mediator Pakistan made "significant progress" in the latest talks with Tehran that focused on measures such as prevention of further escalation of the conflict and the reopening of the Strait of Hormuz, the [USN:L6N44M071 TEXT:"Pakistani military"] said in a statement on Tuesday. "The Iranian president candidly shared his government's perspective and we had a very constructive exchange on the issues involved," Interior Minister Mohsin Naqvi, who accompanied army chief Asim Munir to Tehran, said on X. LITTLE SIGN OF DIPLOMATIC SOLUTION Struggling to resolve an unpopular war that has pushed up energy prices, the administration of President Donald Trump appears to be counting on further economic pressure, even though Iran has spent decades under layers of U.S. and international sanctions that have battered its economy but have not deterred its leadership. Despite no major strikes by either side in weeks, the war shows little sign of reaching a [USN:L1N44L090 TEXT:"diplomatic solution"]. The United States is seeking new ways to end Iranian attacks on ships in the Gulf and, more recently via its allies, [USN:L1N44L08M TEXT:"in the Red Sea"]. Almost six months have passed since the U.S. and Israel launched strikes on Iran. Thousands of people have died, most of them in Iran and Lebanon. While the war has degraded much of Iran's conventional military capacity, inflicted economic pain and killed then-[USN:L6N43B0GV TEXT:"Supreme Leader Ayatollah Ali Khamenei,"] Iran has preserved enough missile and drone capability to attack Gulf neighbors and threaten oil tankers in the Strait of Hormuz. The exact state of Iran's nuclear program, which the Americans and Israelis aim to wipe out, remains unknown. Despite Monday's news, [USN:L1N44K05C TEXT:"oil prices fell"] more than $2 a barrel, though investors braced for the prospect of further supply disruptions from the Middle East. CHINESE OIL TRADE Asked why he stopped short of imposing penalties on Iran and declined to identify targeted countries, Bessent responded, "Why would I want to blow up the global financial system?" He said he wanted to give countries and companies time to sever ties. Bessent previously urged cooperation from China, the biggest buyer of Iranian oil for several years, although the U.S. blockade of Iran's ports, renewed in mid-July, has already [USN:L4N44L0FN TEXT:"cut Iranian oil flows"] to China. Experts say Washington is wary of Chinese retaliation for any sanctions on its banks ahead of expected talks next month between Trump and Chinese President Xi Jinping, with any curbs on China's exports of critical minerals especially sensitive. Asked about Chinese banks on Monday, Bessent said, "We want to make clear here today that no one is above the reach of U.S. sanctions." The Chinese Foreign Ministry said sanctions and pressure tactics do not help and Beijing would do what was necessary to protect China's interests.

item.title: Global Market Today: Asian stocks dip after US tech selloff, gold gains
item.description: Asian markets followed Wall Street's downward trend as caution in technology stocks seeped into trading. Meanwhile, gold prices soared for the fifth day straight, hitting impressive highs. Investors are on the edge of their seats awaiting Nvidia's earnings announcement, which is expected to sway market sentiment. Federal Reserve Chair Kevin Warsh's upcoming speech also promises insights into the economic landscape.
item.dc:creator: Bloomberg
item.content:encoded: Asian equities followed Wall Street lower as investors cut exposure to technology shares ahead of earnings that may test confidence in the artificial intelligence trade. Gold climbed for a fifth consecutive day.The MSCI Asia Pacific equities gauge slipped 0.4% with benchmarks in Japan and South Korea falling. Earlier, a selloff in semiconductor giants dragged the Nasdaq 100 Index down nearly 1% on Monday. Nvidia Corp. fell for a seventh straight session — the longest losing streak since 2022. Equity-index futures for US stocks edged lower in early Asian trading.Elsewhere, global crude oil benchmark Brent was little changed on Tuesday, trading around $92.20 a barrel after US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent threatened economic punishment against any country doing business with Iran. The commodity fell more than 2% on Monday, snapping a six-day rally.Read more: Investors’ equity rush helps SIP assets triple in five yearsLower energy prices lifted Treasuries on Monday, with the 10-year yield falling four basis points to 4.70%. Gold rose 0.5% to near $4,680 an ounce, hovering around levels last seen in May as the US Treasury’s intervention in the bond market revived concerns about fiscal policy and its impact on the dollar.Investors are weighing mounting geopolitical risks against a packed week of economic data and corporate earnings, with the outlook for technology shares emerging as a key test for broader risk sentiment. Nvidia’s results on Wednesday will be closely watched for signs that the recent weakness in chipmakers has further to run.“Details about US economic sanctions on Iran, the Treasury’s attempts to lower long-term yields, and economic data may shape much of the sentiment backdrop,” said Chris Larkin at E*Trade from Morgan Stanley. “But Nvidia and other tech earnings are positioned to be a major weight on the market’s momentum scale.”Investors are also looking for clues on how the US central bank will respond to stubborn inflation when Federal Reserve Chair Kevin Warsh speaks at its annual gathering in Jackson Hole, Wyoming.With Treasury yields still elevated by sticky inflation and concerns over fiscal deficits, traders are watching for any clear guidance from Warsh on how the Fed might respond over the rest of the year.Earlier, Treasuries were also supported by a CNBC report that the Treasury Department could tap its cash pile to fund buybacks of higher-yielding older securities in an effort to curb borrowing costs.Bessent, however, stopped short of signaling any changes to US debt management in a speech Monday following the report.“We haven’t bought a single bond yet,” Bessent said when asked in a press conference whether he’s going to soon increase the buybacks.In tariff news, the Canadian dollar was little changed after Canadian ministers were set to announce a response to US tariffs on Tuesday.Back to the technology sector, Nvidia shares fell 2.9% after the company had notified customers of AI-related price increases on systems shipped early next year.Nvidia’s results have become an important gauge of the artificial intelligence trade, which has come under pressure in recent months as investors question whether massive spending on the technology will translate into commensurate profits.“This is a key week for markets with Nvidia’s earnings and the annual Jackson Hole speech, which normally wouldn’t have a link, but Nvidia needs to impress in order to keep one leg of the stock market stable, and Warsh needs to provide clarity on interest rates in order to keep the other leg of the stock market stable,” said Richard Reyle, chief investment officer at Questar Capital Partners.

item.title: 仏議会、予算巡り「真剣な」議論必要 国債利回り上昇受け政府報道官
item.description: [パリ ２４日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
[パリ ２４日 ロイター] - フランスのブレジョン政府報道官は２４日、国債利回りの上昇を受け、議会で予算に関する「真剣な」議論が必要になると述べた。政府は財政赤字の削減と消費者への過度な負担回避の両立を目指している。

ブレジョン氏は「これら全てには明らかに厳しい取り組みが求められる」と述べた上で、政府は国民への増税を避けつつ、財政状況の改善と赤字削減を目指す方針を改めて示した。

フランス１０年国債の利回りは先週、２００８年以来の高水準となる４．１３％超に達した。

政府が２７年の大統領選挙を前に赤字抑制を図る中、議会での予算審議は難航が予想される。世論調査によると、大統領選では極右勢力が優位に立つ可能性がある。

レスキュール財務相もこの日、政府は財政赤字を可能な限り５％に近い水準に抑えるためあらゆる手を尽くすと述べていた。

欧州委員会は、フランスの２６年財政赤字を対国内総生産（ＧＤＰ）比５．１％と予想している。これは欧州連合（ＥＵ）加盟国に義務付けられている赤字上限３％のルールに抵触する水準となる。

item.title: Alabama launches probe into OpenAI after Hugging Face breach
item.description: Alabama's attorney general said on Monday the state had opened an investigation into OpenAI after its models hacked technology company Hugging Face last month, raising concerns about how artificial intelligence firms control their powerful systems.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Alabama's attorney general said on Monday the state had opened an investigation into OpenAI after its models hacked technology company Hugging Face last month, raising concerns about how artificial intelligence firms control their powerful systems. Here are a few details: Last week, [USN:L4N42G1RA TEXT:"IPO-bound"] OpenAI said it would [USN:L6N44F16D TEXT:"slow"] the pace of model development while overhauling its research and training systems after company officials were caught unawares when an AI agent being tested hacked Hugging Face. The agent went on a days-long hacking spree that OpenAI did not notice until well after the threat was contained and the FBI was alerted, Reuters [USN:L6N43Q12M TEXT:"reported"]. The investigation comes after a multi-state coalition, including Alabama, sent a letter earlier this month to OpenAI demanding transparency and accountability regarding the incident, Alabama Attorney General Steve Marshall's office said. The ChatGPT maker is conducting a thorough review along with external advisers after the Hugging Face breach, an OpenAI spokesperson said, adding that the company will share a technical report with relevant government authorities and publish findings upon completion of the review. The probe seeks to address whether OpenAI's "inability or unwillingness to ensure the safety of its products violated Alabama's consumer protection laws and poses an ongoing risk of substantial harm to the citizens of the state," Marshall's office added. The states demanded in their letter that OpenAI cease and desist from testing activities that led to the hack until "OpenAI shows that it can conduct such activities in a controlled and responsible way". "This AI lab leak showed that Alabamians' and Americans' worst fears about artificial intelligence are not just theoretical," Marshall said. Similar incidents at rivals [USN:L4N43W34W TEXT:"Anthropic"] and [USN:L6N4421DM TEXT:"Meta"] (META.O) have fanned concerns about how developers can control increasingly capable AI systems, and intensified U.S. government efforts to improve AI safety as companies race to develop more capable models.

item.title: テニス＝フェデラー氏、エキシビ出場に「緊張」 7年ぶり全米ＯＰで
item.description: ［ニューヨーク ２４日 ロイター］ -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
［ニューヨーク　２４日　ロイター］ - 男子テニスの元世界ランキング１位、ロジャー・フェデラー氏（スイス）が２５日、全米オープン（ＯＰ）の会場で行われるエキシビションイベントに出場する。

全米ＯＰで５連覇を達成しているフェデラー氏が、同大会に最後に出場したのは２０１９年。２０年大会は欠場し、四大大会への出場は２１年ウィンブルドン選手権が最後となったため、かつて栄華を極めたニューヨークの舞台に別れを告げないまま現役生活を終えていた。

フェデラー氏は今回のイベントに向けて「本当の意味で『ありがとう、さようなら』と言える機会になる。それが大切だと感じる人もいると思うし、私にとってもそう。こういう機会を持てるのは素晴らしいこと」と語った。全米ＯＰ５連覇は、オープン化以降の男子では今も最多記録。

長期間、試合形式でプレーしていないフェデラー氏は「正直、緊張している。もう５年くらい、１セットもプレーしていないと思う。明日どうなるか分からない。不安はたくさんあるが、戻ってこられる喜びも大きい」と述べた。

エキシビションには、同じく引退したアンディ・ロディック氏（米国）、アンドレ・アガシ氏（米国）、ジョン・マッケンロー氏（米国）も出場する。

フェデラー氏は２９日に国際テニス殿堂入りする予定。

item.title: ライン川、最近の降雨で水位急上昇 一部で貨物の積載増が可能に
item.description:
[ハンブルク ２４日 ロイター] - ドイツを流れるライン川の水位が最近の降雨を受けて急上昇し、貨物船の積載量が増えつつある。ただ、水深不足の問題は依然として残っている。ドイツ内陸水運当局（ＷＳＶ）が２４日明らかにした。
• 欧州西部を襲った熱波を受けて、ライン川の水位は８月に入って過去最低を記録。ドイツ企業は、物流に混乱が生じたと報告していた。産業界は輸送コスト上昇、物流のボトルネック、生産抑制に苦しんでいた。
• コモディティートレーダーは「船舶はまだ部分積載での航行しかできないが、貨物量を増やせるようになってきた。今週はライン川流域で追加の降雨が予想されており、状況はさらに改善する可能性がある」と語った。
•
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
[ハンブルク ２４日 ロイター] - ドイツを流れるライン川の水位が最近の降雨を受けて急上昇し、貨物船の積載量が増えつつある。ただ、水深不足の問題は依然として残っている。ドイツ内陸水運当局（ＷＳＶ）が２４日明らかにした。

• 欧州西部を襲った熱波を受けて、ライン川の水位は８月に入って過去最低を記録。ドイツ企業は、物流に混乱が生じたと報告していた。産業界は輸送コスト上昇、物流のボトルネック、生産抑制に苦しんでいた。

• コモディティートレーダーは「船舶はまだ部分積載での航行しかできないが、貨物量を増やせるようになってきた。今週はライン川流域で追加の降雨が予想されており、状況はさらに改善する可能性がある」と語った。

• ＷＳＶによると、コブレンツ近郊にある難所カウプの航行可能水位（基準点からの水位）は２４日時点で約６０センチ。先週は約５センチまで低下、２０１８年に観測された過去最低の２５センチを下回った。カウプで貨物船を満載状態で航行させるために通常必要とされる水位は約１．５メートル。

• ８月中旬には水深不足のため、多くの船舶がカウプ通過を停止していた。トレーダーらによると、一部の船舶は現在、７００─８００トンの少量積載でカウプ通過を再開している。

item.title: 【日本市況】株式持ち直す、エヌビディア決算前に打診買い－債券下落
item.description: （ブルームバーグ）：
item.dc:creator: Bloomberg
item.content:encoded:
（ブルームバーグ）： 25日の東京市場では株式が持ち直した。米エヌビディア決算を前に値下がりしていた半導体関連株の一角に打診買いが入った。債券は小幅下落（金利は上昇）。円は対ドル159円前半で推移している。

一時900円超値下がりした日経平均は、上昇して午前の取引を終えた。下落していたアドバンテストは下げ幅を縮め、東京エレクトロンはプラスに転じた。米国がカナダから輸入する自動車に対して、関税を現行の2倍にすると表明したことで自動車株は安い。債券は先物や長期債が下げ、円はニューヨーク終値付近で推移している。

ベッセント米財務長官は24日、イランと取引するあらゆる国に経済的な制裁を科すと警告した。ただ、原油相場への影響は限定的で、金融市場はジャクソンホール会合（米カンザスシティー連銀主催の年次シンポジウム）といったイベントを控えて全般は手控えムードが強い。

SMBC日興証券の丸山義正チーフマーケットエコノミストは、対イランの新たな作戦でベッセント氏は具体的制裁などを十分に明らかにしておらず、実効性に疑問を提示させると述べた。同時にあえて曖昧にしているとも考えられ、どの程度実効性を発揮するかを金融市場が把握するためには一定の時間を要するだろうと25日付リポートで指摘した。

日経平均は午前の終了に受けて急速に戻した。電気機器指数が下げ幅を縮めた。銀行株や保険株は買われ、TOPIXは上げ幅を拡大して午前の取引を終えた。

東洋証券の大塚竜太ストラテジストは「エヌビディア決算への警戒で売られていた半導体関連株に押し目買いが入っている」として、韓国株の下げ幅縮小も追い風だと述べた。エヌビディア決算は数字そのものは強い可能性が高い一方、株価は下落基調が続いており、決算後に大きく下げる展開は見込みづらいと指摘している。

野村アセットマネジメントの石黒英之チーフ・ストラテジストも、エヌビディアの決算に向けたハードルは下がっており、ポジティブな決算が出ればそこを起点に切り返しやすく、日本株にもプラスになるだろうと述べた。

item.title: South Korea's SK Hynix union members reject wage agreement in vote
item.description: South Korean chipmaker SK Hynix's union members narrowly rejected a tentative wage agreement on Tuesday, according to a source familiar with the matter.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: South Korean chipmaker SK Hynix's (000660.KS) union members narrowly rejected a tentative wage agreement on Tuesday, according to a source familiar with the matter. A total of 50.08% of the 15,045 workers who cast ballots voted against the agreement, the source said. The difference was just 25 votes, the source added. SK Hynix was not immediately available for comment when contacted by Reuters. The source spoke on condition of anonymity as they were not authorised to speak to media. The agreement, reached last week, included a 6.3% wage increase and a revision to SK Hynix's profit-sharing bonus scheme, under which 40% of bonuses would be paid in cash and 60% in company shares. The world's second-largest memory chipmaker has been reaping strong profits from booming demand for high-bandwidth memory (HBM) chips used in artificial intelligence applications. Last year, the two sides agreed to set aside 10% of annual operating profit to fund profit-sharing bonus payments under a system to remain in place for 10 years. Under the agreement, 80% of the bonus is paid in cash in the year it is awarded, while the remaining 20% is deferred over two years. However, this year, management's proposal to pay more than half of bonuses in shares met with opposition from some workers concerned about the volatility of SK Hynix's shares. The stock hit a record high in June on enthusiasm over the AI boom before slumping on fears that too much money is being spent with insufficient reward. In May, Samsung Electronics (005930.KS) and its unionised workers [USN:L1N424013 TEXT:"agreed on a deal"] on performance pay, averting a major strike at the chipmaker that had threatened to disrupt supplies. Samsung agreed to allocate 10.5% of its annual semiconductor operating profit to special bonuses for chip workers. The bonuses would be paid in company stock, with the immediate sale of a majority of the shares to be restricted. Shares of SK Hynix were trading down 4.9%, compared with 2.2% decline in the benchmark KOSPI (.KS11) as of 0036 GMT.

item.title: Bessent's D-Day sanctions are more Anzio, but Iran response is key
item.description: U.S. Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent invoked the famous D-Day landing of Allied troops in France in 1944 when announcing new sanctions against Iran.
item.dc:creator: Clyde Russell
item.content:encoded: U.S. Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent invoked the famous D-Day landing of Allied troops in France in 1944 when announcing new sanctions against Iran. But the measures are better compared to another World War Two amphibious landing, the considerably less successful Anzio beachhead in Italy. The Anzio battle was marked by the initial success of Allied landings, but a lack of decisive leadership saw the campaign stall and turn into a months-long campaign of attrition that largely failed to achieve its initial objectives. Bessent's new [USN:L6N44K07T TEXT:"measures"] aim to strangle Iran economically and target countries and corporates doing business with the Islamic Republic in five sectors, namely digital assets, technology, gold, aviation and shipping. But rather than going for broke up front, Bessent is putting countries on notice that they will have to work with the United States or face losing access to the global dollar-based financial system. In other words, the new measures are more of a threat than a reality. But even if they do become reality there are doubts as to whether they will be effective enough to force Iran's rulers to capitulate, or indeed whether they will be severe enough to force a desperate Iranian populace to successfully rise up and overthrow their clerical rulers. Iran has proven adept at getting around sanctions in the past by setting up new front companies and working with its allies such as China. With Beijing unlikely to join any U.S. sanctions, it would mean that Bessent would have to be willing to impose measures against Chinese banks, refiners, shippers and traders, a level of escalation that Washington may be cautious about pursuing. What the new sanctions do achieve is to confirm that a diplomatic solution to the Iran conflict is a distant option, and they reinforce the view being put forward by the administration of President Donald Trump that some form of victory is still possible. Another lesson from history is that when both sides in a war are convinced they can still win and that time is on their side, the conflict will continue until this calculation shifts. IRANIAN RESPONSE The key for energy markets will be how Iran responds. The messaging so far on social media has been belligerent, but Iran has also yet to renew missile and drone attacks on energy and other infrastructure in Gulf nations hosting U.S. bases, such as Kuwait, Qatar and Bahrain. Tehran has also not been able to fully close the Strait of Hormuz, and while there is some [USN:L1N44L00N TEXT:"dispute"] over the actual volume of crude moving through the narrow waterway, the key point is it's not zero and every barrel that gets through lessens Iran's leverage. Iran is also feeling pain from the existing U.S. blockade of its ports, a measure that is proving far more effective than financial sanctions. Iran exported an average of 1.75 million barrels per day (bpd) of crude in the three months leading up to the U.S. and Israeli attacks on February 28, according to data compiled by commodity analysts Kpler. This has plunged to just 255,000 bpd in August, down from 893,000 bpd in July and even weaker than the 259,000 bpd from May, which was the lowest since May 2020, a period when crude demand was hit by the COVID-19 pandemic. The problem for Bessent and Trump is that the more their blockade and economic sanctions work, the more they incentivise Iran to hit back with every military means at its disposal. If Iran's leaders see themselves in an existential battle, they are unlikely to meekly accept being economically throttled without attempting to wrest back the initiative through hitting infrastructure and vessels across the Gulf. The uncertainty of Iran's response is likely to keep a nervous premium in crude oil prices. Global benchmark Brent futures did ease after Bessent's announcement, falling around 2.4% on Monday to $92.17 a barrel. But this is still 31% higher than the $70.14 a barrel they dropped to during the brief ceasefire between the U.S. and Iran, which lasted from mid-June to early July. Enjoying this column? Check out Reuters Open Interest (ROI) , your essential new source for global financial commentary. ROI delivers thought-provoking, data-driven analysis of everything from swap rates to soybeans. Markets are moving faster than ever. ROI can help you keep up. Follow ROI on LinkedIn and X . The views expressed here are those of the author, a columnist for Reuters.

item.title: Venezuela ha firmado más de 50 acuerdos en petróleo y gas: Presidenta encargada
item.description: La presidenta encargada de Venezuela, Delcy Rodríguez, dijo el lunes que se han suscrito 50 acuerdos estratégicos en petróleo y gas, en convenios que incorporarán nuevas inversiones en más de 76 áreas productivas de hidrocarburos en el país.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: La presidenta encargada de Venezuela, Delcy Rodríguez, dijo el lunes que se han suscrito 50 acuerdos estratégicos en petróleo y gas, en convenios que incorporarán nuevas inversiones en más de 76 áreas productivas de hidrocarburos en el país. Rodríguez, en un mensaje a la nación, no dio detalles sobre todos los documentos suscritos, aunque desde inicios de año varias empresas, la mayoría energéticas e internacionales, han llegado acuerdos y firmado convenios para desarrollar áreas petroleras. La funcionaria dijo que actualmente la producción petrolera es de 1,230 barriles por día o "su nivel más alto desde febrero de 2019"

item.title: バーナム英首相、来月訪米へ－ウクライナ支援でトランプ氏に働きかけ
item.description: （ブルームバーグ）：
item.dc:creator: Bloomberg
item.content:encoded:
（ブルームバーグ）： 英国のバーナム首相は、冬季を前にウクライナが地対空ミサイルシステム「パトリオット」用の迎撃ミサイルについて、米国の在庫の一部を確保できるようトランプ大統領に働きかけるため、自身と他の欧州首脳が来月訪米する予定だと明らかにした。

24日夕方にキーウでブルームバーグのインタビューに応じ、ニューヨークで開催される国連総会に向け「9月にニューヨークへ行くのを楽しみにしている」と述べた。首相就任後、初の訪米となる。

バーナム氏は「詳細はまだ完全には固まっていないが、特に今日の協議を踏まえると、行く可能性が高い」と指摘。今回のキーウ訪問を受け、「今後数週間で何をすべきかはかなり明確になった」と述べた。

首相就任後初の外遊でウクライナを訪れたバーナム氏は、ウクライナ支援国の会合で初めて議長を務め、ウクライナのゼレンスキー大統領とも二国間会談を行った。

ゼレンスキー氏は欧州各国と米国に対し、ウクライナがパトリオット用迎撃ミサイルを確保し、ロシアがエネルギーインフラへの攻撃を再び激化させると予想される冬までに在庫を補充できるよう、繰り返し支援を求めている。迎撃ミサイルはロシアの巡航ミサイルや弾道ミサイルを撃墜する上で最も強力な兵器だ。

バーナム氏は、迎撃ミサイルの在庫不足でロシアの弾道ミサイル攻撃への防御に苦戦するウクライナの現状について、解決可能だという「非常に楽観的」な感触を得て帰路につくと述べた。

同氏によると、欧州首脳は米国の迎撃ミサイルや他国の在庫を確保することを念頭に、国連総会に合わせて有志連合の会合を再び開くことを検討している。

バーナム氏は「それが最も可能性の高い方向性のように思える。まだ決まってはいないが、大半の人がその方向で考えているようだった」と語った。

さらに、英国はウクライナが必要とするパトリオット用ミサイルを使用していないものの、他の欧州諸国が一段と対応を強化する必要があると強調。「われわれが影響力を持ち、支援に加われる他のプレーヤーもいる」とし、「おそらく多くの段階と多くの交渉を伴う解決策になるだろう」と話した。

item.title: 仏大統領選、メランション氏決選投票へ ルペン氏と対決か＝世論調査
item.description: [パリ ２４日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
[パリ ２４日 ロイター] - 来年のフランス大統領選で、極左指導者ジャンリュック・メランション氏が決選投票で極右候補マリーヌ・ルペン氏の対立候補となる可能性が最も高いことが、２４日発表の世論調査で示された。フランスの有権者間の深刻な分断が浮き彫りになった。

急進左派「不屈のフランス（ＬＦＩ）」の候補であるメランション氏は、５つの想定シナリオのうち少なくとも３つで決選投票に進む見込みで、４つ目のシナリオでは２位で並んだ。

この結果は、分断が進む有権者への働きかけに苦戦している中道派候補に厳しい内容となった。

中道派候補のエドゥアール・フィリップ氏は２４日、「ルペン氏とメランション氏が決選投票で対決するリスクは現実的で深刻だ」と記者団に述べた。

調査によると、第１回投票でメランション氏が１６─１７％、ルペン氏が３５─３８％の票を獲得する見込み。決選投票ではルペン氏が６４％の票を得てメランション氏に勝利するとみられている。

メランション氏は２０１２年、１７年、２２年と過去に３度大統領選に立候補しているが、一度も決選投票に進出していない。

item.title: Premiê britânico diz que Reino Unido deve ser “mais ousado” na busca por laços com a UE
item.description: O primeiro-ministro britânico, Andy Burnham, disse ao presidente do Conselho Europeu, António Costa, que Londres deve ser mais ousada na busca por laços mais estreitos com a União Europeia, e que a cúpula entre o Reino Unido e a UE prevista para este ano oferece essa oportunidade, informou seu gabinete nesta segunda-feira.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: O primeiro-ministro britânico, Andy Burnham, disse ao presidente do Conselho Europeu, António Costa, que Londres deve ser mais ousada na busca por laços mais estreitos com a União Europeia, e que a cúpula entre o Reino Unido e a UE prevista para este ano oferece essa oportunidade, informou seu gabinete nesta segunda-feira. Burnham se reuniu com Costa no final do domingo, durante viagem a Kiev para copresidir uma reunião da chamada “Coalizão dos Dispostos”, em sua primeira visita à Ucrânia desde que assumiu o cargo de primeiro-ministro. Segundo seu gabinete, Burnham disse a Costa que o Reino Unido deveria aproveitar a cooperação existente em defesa e segurança com os aliados europeus e buscar uma colaboração mais estreita em todas as esferas do relacionamento. O líder britânico disse a Costa que o Reino Unido “precisa ser mais ousado no sentido de se aproximar do bloco”, afirmou uma porta-voz de Downing Street sobre as conversas entre os dois líderes. “Isso inclui aproveitar os laços estreitos de defesa e segurança já estabelecidos entre o Reino Unido e os aliados europeus para promover uma maior cooperação em todas as áreas do relacionamento.”

item.title: サッカー＝日本代表ＦＷ小川が町田に移籍、今夏のＷ杯出場
item.description: ［２４日 ロイター］ -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
［２４日　ロイター］ - サッカーのＪ１町田は２４日、オランダ１部ＮＥＣナイメヘンから日本代表ＦＷ小川航基（２９）が完全移籍で加入すると発表した。

小川は町田の公式サイトを通じて「ＦＣ町田ゼルビアの一員として戦えることを、とてもうれしく思う。たくさんのゴールを決め、優勝に貢献できるように全力で戦う」とコメントした。

神奈川県出身の小川は桐光学園高から磐田入り。その後、水戸、横浜ＦＣなどでプレーし、ＮＥＣに移籍した。Ｊ１では通算３８試合７得点、Ｊ２では１１４試合４３得点を記録している。

日本代表では国際Ａマッチ１８試合に出場して１１得点。２０２６年ワールドカップ（Ｗ杯）北中米大会の日本代表メンバーにも選出された。

item.title: サッカー＝ウォルフスブルク塩貝フル出場、シャルケ田中は延長戦でプレー
item.description: ［２４日 ロイター］ -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
［２４日　ロイター］ - サッカーのドイツ・カップ（杯）は２４日、各地で１回戦を行い、ウォルフスブルク（２部）の塩貝健人はＶＳＧアルトグリーニッケ（４部）戦に先発し、延長戦を含め最後まで出場した。試合は延長を終えて３─３となり、ウォルフスブルクがＰＫ戦を６─５で制した。

シャルケの田中聡はハレシャーＦＣ（４部）戦でベンチ入りし、延長後半開始から途中出場した。シャルケは延長の末、５─２で勝利した。

item.title: インドのイラン向け輸出、米制裁やＵＡＥ措置でさらに減少へ
item.description:
Manoj Kumar Rajendra Jadhav Mayank Bhardwaj
[ニューデリー ２４日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
Manoj Kumar　Rajendra Jadhav　Mayank Bhardwaj

[ニューデリー ２４日 ロイター] - インドの輸出業者は２４日、米国がイランに対して計画している新たな制裁措置と、アラブ首長国連邦（ＵＡＥ）によるイランとの貿易停止措置が、イラン向けのコメ、茶、医薬品の輸出に深刻な支障をきたす可能性があると述べた。

インドはイランの貿易相手トップ５の一つとなっているが、２国間貿易額は２０１８／１９年度のピークである１７０億ドルから９０％以上減少しており、現在の輸出は主に人道的な理由で制裁を免除された品目に限定されている。

米トランプ政権は２４日、イランとビジネス関係を持つ国々に対して関係を断つよう警告し、応じなければ二次制裁の対象にすると表明した。「経済版Ｄデー」と銘打った措置の一環だが、財務省は実際の制裁発動には踏み切らなかった。

ＵＡＥは先週、追って通知があるまで、イランとの全ての貿易活動、金融取引を停止した。

印コメ輸出業者連盟のデブ・ガルグ副会長は「従来ＵＡＥを経由していた取引・決済メカニズムについて、代替地を模索している兆候がすでにある」と述べ、代替先としてトルコを挙げた。

item.title: Orçamento de 2027 está encaminhado e salário mínimo será de R$1.741, diz Durigan
item.description: O ministro da Fazenda, Dario Durigan, afirmou nesta segunda-feira que o projeto da Lei Orçamentária Anual (PLOA) de 2027 está bem encaminhado dentro do governo e que já foi definido o valor do salário mínimo em R$1.741 para o ano que vem, valor resultante de reajustes previstos na legislação.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: O ministro da Fazenda, Dario Durigan, afirmou nesta segunda-feira que o projeto da Lei Orçamentária Anual (PLOA) de 2027 está bem encaminhado dentro do governo e que já foi definido o valor do salário mínimo em R$1.741 para o ano que vem, valor resultante de reajustes previstos na legislação. Durigan, que fez questão de destacar que está mantida a indexação de outros benefícios ao salário mínimo, esteve reunido mais cedo com o presidente Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva e a ministra da Casa Civil, Miriam Belchior. "O salário mínimo, com os reajustes previstos em lei, chega a R$1.741 no ano que vem e ele, necessariamente cumprindo a legislação brasileira, dentro do nosso espírito de privilegiar a população mais carente, vai também para a Previdência, vai também para os benefícios que têm a indexação com o salário mínimo", disse o ministro a jornalistas. "O Orçamento está muito bem encaminhado, com o salário mínimo definido", acrescentou. O salário mínimo é reajustado anualmente levando-se em conta a inflação do período e a variação do PIB de dois anos antes, mas a valorização é sujeita a limitações do arcabouço fiscal. Segundo Durigan, o PLOA deve já prever o novo modelo da reforma tributária. O Executivo federal tem, segundo regras constitucionais, até o dia 31 de agosto para encaminhar ao Congresso seu projeto de lei orçamentária para o ano seguinte. O Congresso, por sua vez, tem até 22 de dezembro, em tese, para devolver o projeto -- já votado -- para sanção presidencial.

item.title: Seul diz que Coreia do Sul e EUA se comprometem a manter cooperação estreita em relação à Coreia do Norte
item.description: O ministro das Relações Exteriores da Coreia do Sul, Cho Hyun, e o secretário de Estado dos EUA, Marco Rubio, conversaram nesta segunda-feira, e o governo sul-coreano informou que ambos concordaram em manter uma comunicação e cooperação estreitas para resolver a questão nuclear norte-coreana, segundo noticiou a agência de notícias sul-coreana Yonhap.
item.dc:creator: David Brunnstrom
item.content:encoded: O ministro das Relações Exteriores da Coreia do Sul, Cho Hyun, e o secretário de Estado dos EUA, Marco Rubio, conversaram nesta segunda-feira, e o governo sul-coreano informou que ambos concordaram em manter uma comunicação e cooperação estreitas para resolver a questão nuclear norte-coreana, segundo noticiou a agência de notícias sul-coreana Yonhap. O Departamento de Estado dos EUA divulgou apenas uma breve declaração sobre a conversa telefônica, que ocorre em um momento de tensão entre os aliados. O presidente Donald Trump anunciou recentemente uma redução nos exercícios militares conjuntos e elogiou a Coreia do Norte, que possui armas nucleares, ao mesmo tempo em que afirmou que Seul não havia ajudado em seus esforços para tentar desnuclearizar o Irã. O Departamento de Estado informou que Rubio e Cho discutiram “uma série de questões relacionadas à Aliança EUA-ROK”, referindo-se à Coreia do Sul pelas iniciais em inglês de seu nome oficial, República da Coreia. “O secretário destacou a necessidade de os dois países permanecerem em estreita coordenação em assuntos que são essenciais para a aliança”, acrescentou. A Yonhap informou que, em um comunicado sobre as conversas, o Ministério das Relações Exteriores da Coreia do Sul não mencionou se os diplomatas reafirmaram seu compromisso habitual com a desnuclearização da Coreia do Norte, apesar de terem enfatizado a importância da cooperação na questão nuclear norte-coreana. “O ministro e o secretário concordaram em manter uma comunicação e cooperação estreitas entre a Coreia do Sul e os EUA em prol da paz na Península Coreana e da resolução da questão nuclear norte-coreana, ao mesmo tempo em que mantêm uma postura sólida de defesa conjunta”, informou a Yonhap, citando o comunicado do ministério. A agência citou Cho afirmando que Seul faria o possível para ajudar a garantir que a recente mensagem de Trump à Coreia do Norte levasse à retomada do diálogo entre Washington e Pyongyang e à paz na península. ABERTURA DE TRUMP TESTA ALIANÇA O gesto de paz de Trump a Kim Jong Un, da Coreia do Norte, na semana passada, aliado às suas críticas a Seul, gerou preocupação entre analistas de que a imprevisibilidade de Trump possa prejudicar as alianças que há muito mantêm a paz na Ásia. Cho afirmou na semana passada que a ordem de Trump para reduzir os exercícios militares parecia ter como objetivo, em parte, pressionar Seul a apoiar os esforços dos EUA na guerra contra o Irã, além de outras questões ainda não resolvidas, como investimentos. Ele disse que uma possível fonte de atrito poderia ser o compromisso da Coreia do Sul de investir US$350 bilhões nos Estados Unidos, no âmbito de um acordo comercial assinado no ano passado. Seul ainda não anunciou detalhes do plano de investimento, embora Cho tenha dito que Washington tinha enviado a Seul uma proposta delineando projetos que poderiam ser considerados. A Yonhap citou o comunicado do ministério, segundo o qual os dois lados concordaram em trabalhar em prol de resultados “mutuamente benéficos” em várias questões pendentes, incluindo tarifas, investimentos e cooperação em segurança. A agência informou que Cho ressaltou o compromisso do governo de Seul em fazer contribuições substanciais para ajudar a restaurar a livre passagem pelo Estreito de Ormuz, ao mesmo tempo em que destacou a liderança ativa de Trump e dos EUA na abordagem da questão do Oriente Médio. A agência informou que Cho e Rubio concordaram em se reunir em breve para discutir em profundidade as principais questões pendentes.

item.title: ウクライナ、ロシア通販2位オゾンへの攻撃拡大 物流拠点4カ所で新たな被害
item.description: ロシアのネット通販大手オゾンは24日、同国南部にある物流拠点4カ所でウクライナ軍によるドローン攻撃を受けたと発表した。このうち、ダゲスタン共和国マハチカラの物流拠点で火災が発生した。 ロイターは建物、駐車場、道路の配置、塔が衛星画像や過去の画像と一致することから、場所を確認した。 また、アディゲ共和国アディゲイスクおよびスタブロポリ地方ネビンノムイスクにある倉庫でも従業員が退避した。今回の攻撃で、今月22日に初めて攻撃を受けて以降、標的となった同社施設は計6カ所となった。 オゾンは声明で、操業を停止したマハチカラの施設について「暫定情報によると、数人が負傷した」と述べた。 同社はまた、クラスノダール地方エネムにある施設で大規模な火災が発生したことも明らかにした。アディゲとスタブロポリの施設に損傷はなかったとしている。 ロシアのネット通販大手がウクライナのドローン攻撃の標的となるのは、競合のワイルドベリーズに続き、オゾンが2社目と
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded: ロシアのネット通販大手オゾンは24日、同国南部にある物流拠点4カ所でウクライナ軍によるドローン攻撃を受けたと発表した。このうち、ダゲスタン共和国マハチカラの物流拠点で火災が発生した。 ロイターは建物、駐車場、道路の配置、塔が衛星画像や過去の画像と一致することから、場所を確認した。 また、アディゲ共和国アディゲイスクおよびスタブロポリ地方ネビンノムイスクにある倉庫でも従業員が退避した。今回の攻撃で、今月22日に初めて攻撃を受けて以降、標的となった同社施設は計6カ所となった。 オゾンは声明で、操業を停止したマハチカラの施設について「暫定情報によると、数人が負傷した」と述べた。 同社はまた、クラスノダール地方エネムにある施設で大規模な火災が発生したことも明らかにした。アディゲとスタブロポリの施設に損傷はなかったとしている。 ロシアのネット通販大手がウクライナのドローン攻撃の標的となるのは、競合のワイルドベリーズに続き、オゾンが2社目となった。同社施設が初めて攻撃を受けたのは今月22日で、被害を受けたサマラ州の物流センターは業務停止を余儀なくされた。

item.title: ＭＬＢ＝アストロズ、今井獲得のブラウンＧＭと契約解除 双方合意
item.description: ［２４日 ロイター］ -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
［２４日　ロイター］ - 米大リーグ（ＭＬＢ）のアストロズは２４日、今季終了まで残っていたダナ・ブラウンＧＭ（５９）との契約を双方合意の下で解除した。

２０２３年からＧＭ職を務めていたブラウン氏は１年目でア・リーグ優勝決定シリーズに進出。２４年はワイルドカードシリーズで敗退し、２５年は１６年以来初めてプレーオフ進出を逃した。今季は現時点でア・リーグ西地区の首位タイだが６５勝６６敗と負け越し、直近８試合では６敗を喫していた。

ブラウンＧＭの特筆すべき動きとしては、２４年オフに主力のカイル・タッカー外野手をカブスに放出し、その見返りとしてアイザック・パレデス内野手、ヘイデン・ウェズネスキー投手、キャム・スミス外野手を獲得したトレードが挙げられる。今年１月にはプロ野球の西武からポスティングシステムを利用してＭＬＢ移籍を目指した今井達也投手を獲得した。

ブラウン氏は「ＭＬＢのＧＭとして初めて務める機会を与えてくれた（球団オーナー兼会長の）ジム・クレーン氏に感謝する」とコメント。職務は３人のＧＭ補佐と、かつての主砲で現在はシニアアドバイザーを務める殿堂入り強打者のジェフ・バグウェル氏が引き継ぎ、移行期間中はクレーン氏が自ら野球部門の運営を統括する。

item.title: South Korea and US vow close cooperation on North Korea
item.description: US President Donald Trump's olive branch to North Korea's Kim Jong Un last week, coupled with his criticism of Seoul, has raised concern among analysts that Trump's unpredictability could strain alliances that have long maintained peace in Asia.
item.dc:creator: CNA
item.content:encoded:
Advertisement

East Asia

South Korea and US vow close cooperation on North Korea

US President Donald Trump's olive branch to North Korea's Kim Jong Un last week, coupled with his criticism of Seoul, has raised concern among analysts that Trump's unpredictability could strain alliances that have long maintained peace in Asia.

US Secretary of State Marco Rubio poses for a photo with South Korean Foreign Minister Cho Hyun during a trilateral meeting on the sidelines of the NATO leaders' summit, in Ankara, Turkey, on Jul 7, 2026. (File photo: Reuters/Yves Herman)

FAST

WASHINGTON: South Korean Foreign Minister Cho Hyun and US Secretary of State Marco Rubio spoke on Monday (Aug 24), and Seoul said they agreed to maintain close communication and cooperation on resolving the North Korean nuclear issue, South Korea's Yonhap news agency reported. The US State Department issued only a brief statement on the phone call, which comes at a period of tension between the allies. President Donald Trump recently announced a scaling back of joint military exercises and praised nuclear-armed North Korea, while saying that Seoul had not helped his efforts to try to denuclearise Iran. The State Department said Rubio and Cho discussed "a range of issues in the US-ROK Alliance", referring to South Korea by the initials of its official name, the Republic of Korea. "The Secretary noted the need for the two countries to remain in close coordination on matters that are integral to the Alliance," it added.

Yonhap said that in a statement on their talks, South Korea's Foreign Ministry did not mention whether the diplomats reaffirmed their usual commitment to North Korea's denuclearisation , despite their emphasis on the importance of cooperation on the North Korean nuclear issue. "The minister and secretary agreed to continue close communication and cooperation between South Korea and the US for peace on the Korean Peninsula and the resolution of North Korea's nuclear issue while maintaining a solid combined defence posture," Yonhap quoted the ministry release as saying. It cited Cho as saying that Seoul would do its best to help ensure Trump's recent message for North Korea would lead to the resumption of dialogue between Washington and Pyongyang, and peace on the peninsula.

Related:

Trump says US scaling back military drills with South Korea, citing 'very good' relationship with Kim Jong Un

CNA Explains: Why is Trump pushing to meet Kim Jong Un again?

TRUMP'S OUTREACH TESTS ALLIANCE Trump's olive branch to North Korea's Kim Jong Un last week, coupled with his criticism of Seoul, has raised concern among analysts that Trump's unpredictability could strain alliances that have long maintained peace in Asia. Cho said last week that Trump's order to curb the military drills appeared aimed in part at pressuring Seoul to support US efforts in the Iran war, alongside other unresolved issues such as investment. He said one potential source of friction could be South Korea's pledge to invest US$350 billion in the United States under a trade deal signed last year. Seoul has yet to announce details of the investment plan, although Cho said Washington had sent Seoul a proposal outlining projects that could be considered. Yonhap cited the ministry statement as saying that the two sides agreed to work toward "mutually beneficial" outcomes on various pending issues, including tariffs, investment and security cooperation. It said Cho underscored the Seoul government's commitment to making substantive contributions to help restore free passage through the Strait of Hormuz, while noting the active leadership of Trump and the US in addressing the Middle East issue. It said Cho and Rubio agreed to meet in the near future to have in-depth discussions on key pending issues.
